reading.zh: 从左到右是一条口径管道：口径取值（self/dept/company/group_all/group_category）→ 用户数据域解析（多角色取最宽）→ 查询过滤条件 → 越权拦截；归口类别口径作为并行输入汇入过滤。
reading.en: Left to right is one pipeline: scope catalog (self/dept/company/group_all/group_category) → user scope resolution (widest wins) → query filters → access denial; the category scope feeds the filter as a parallel input.
